meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按任务组建由「执行、指挥、评审」三类角色组成的 AI 团队，实时展示各角色的发言与辩论过程，共享同一份项目上下文记忆，并把结果汇总成统一输出。
howto.when: 当你需要多个智能体协同完成复杂任务时触发，例如技术架构决策会议、OPC 系统构建、产品定价策略等场景。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构是否可行
say.note: 各角色轮流发言、辩论，最后给出结论

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 按战略分析→产品架构→工程实现推进

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场、财务、评审角色共同讨论定价

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can assemble an AI team of executors, coordinators, and reviewers for a task, show each role's statements and debates live, share one project context memory, and merge the outputs into a single result.
howto.when_en: It triggers when a task needs several agents working together, such as technical architecture decision meetings, OPC system building, or product pricing strategy.

say_en.text: Use the tech decision team to assess whether microservices work for us
say_en.note: Each role speaks and debates, then a conclusion is given

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short videos
say_en.note: Runs strategy, product design, then engineering

say_en.text: Use the product team to set a pricing strategy for this product
say_en.note: Market, finance, and reviewer roles discuss pricing
